name: Pictology
hero_text: Hand-painted and handmade pysanky eggs, one-of-a-kind collaged cards, stitched felt ornaments and new wax ornaments, all made by Carole in Brattleboro, Vermont.
about_teaser: I'm a folk artist in Brattleboro, Vermont, and a grandma who never quite stopped playing with color. Mostly I hand paint pysanky (Ukrainian wax-and-dye eggs), but you'll also find collaged cards, felt ornaments and wax ornaments coming off my kitchen table.
about_body: I make art under the name Pictology from my home in Brattleboro, Vermont. My first love is pysanky, the Ukrainian tradition of hand painting eggs with beeswax and dye. Each line is drawn in hot wax, the egg goes into a dye bath, and the design builds up color by color until the wax is melted away to reveal it. I studied American Studies and Folklore at Marlboro College, and those old symbols still fascinate me: suns for life and growth, horses for prosperity, sheep for strength, flowers for happiness. Lately I also letter little verses and landscapes onto my eggs, stitch felt ornaments, pour wax ornaments, and make collaged cards just for fun. Every piece is hand painted and handmade, and every one is one of a kind. I would love to hear from you! Tell me which pieces caught your eye, or share a design you might be interested in. I'm happy to talk about custom work: a pysanka with symbols chosen for a wedding, a new baby or a special birthday, a set of cards for the holidays, or ornaments in your favorite colors. Write to me at cmcrompton51@gmail.com and let's make something together.
contact_blurb: Questions about a piece, an order, or a design you'd love to see? Carole would love to hear from you, and she's happy to take custom requests: special symbols, favorite colors, names or dates for a gift.
meta_description: Hand-painted Ukrainian pysanky eggs, one-of-a-kind collaged cards, felt ornaments and $2 wax ornaments, handmade by Carole Crompton in Brattleboro, Vermont. Custom orders welcome.
